package.name: ugv_traversability
package.description: Terrain traversability estimation for the Waveshare UGV: fuses 3D lidar / depth point clouds into a robot-centric 2.5D elevation map and scores each cell by slope, step height and roughness against the robot's wheel radius and ground clearance. Publishes an OccupancyGrid cost map and obstacle / ground clouds for the Nav2 obstacle layer.
